text: The rapid rise of AI has set off a flurry of legal and regulatory activity.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: There is no single AI law to follow.

text: Instead, there are overlapping circles of regulation, where privacy, cybersecurity, consumer protection, employment, and IP laws all continue to apply alongside newer AI-specific rules.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: Europe has its EU AI Act,
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: But the U.S. has no federal equivalent yet.
speaker: SPEAKER_01
